title: 🚨 THE MORE GOD USES YOU, THE MORE CAREFULLY YOU MUST GUARD YOUR HEART.
paragraphs: 🚨 THE MORE GOD USES YOU, THE MORE CAREFULLY YOU MUST GUARD YOUR HEART.

You can preach truth…
lead people…
build a ministry…
grow an audience…
and still quietly begin craving the glory that belongs to God.
That is what makes ministry pride so dangerous.
It rarely says:
“I want to steal God's glory.”
It sounds more spiritual.

“Why didn't they recognize me?”
“Why is their ministry growing faster?”
“Why didn't they invite me?”
“Why aren't people sharing my work?”
“Why am I serving so much and nobody notices?”
And slowly…
serving Jesus can become mixed with wanting to be seen serving Jesus.

📖 HOW TO GUARD YOUR HEART FROM MINISTRY PRIDE
When God Uses You, But Your Heart Starts Wanting the Glory
This isn't only for pastors.

It's for teachers.
Worship leaders.
Christian creators.
Authors.
Ministry workers.
Volunteers.
And anyone God is beginning to use.
Because sometimes the greatest test isn't whether you can handle obscurity.
It's whether you can handle influence without letting influence change your heart.
🔥 WHAT THIS BOOK WILL HELP YOU CONFRONT
Inside, you'll discover:

• How pride can hide inside genuine ministry
• Why applause can become spiritually dangerous
• How comparison exposes what is happening in your heart
• Why your platform must never become your identity
• How to celebrate when God uses someone else
• Why correction is protection, not humiliation
• How secret obedience helps destroy the craving for recognition
• Why repentance must remain normal—even for leaders
• How to grow in influence without becoming addicted to influence
• How to keep Jesus at the center when people begin noticing you
And one question runs through the entire book:
If Jesus receives all the glory and nobody remembers your name… would that still be enough?
John the Baptist gave us the posture:
“He must increase, but I must decrease.” — John 3:30
⚔️ MOST PEOPLE VS. THE FEW

Most people want influence.
Few ask whether their character can carry it.

Most people want a platform.
Few protect their private altar.

Most people enjoy being celebrated.
Few know how to remain humble when applause gets louder.
Most people want God to increase their reach.
Few are willing to decrease so Christ can remain the focus.
Gospel Warrior is calling believers back to something deeper:
Not celebrity Christianity.
Not performance.
Not building monuments to ourselves.
Faithfulness. Repentance. Humility. Obedience. Jesus.
The vision is bigger than one book.

We're building a growing discipleship library filled with Christian resources designed to strengthen your faith, confront compromise, deepen biblical understanding, develop spiritual discipline, and help you follow Jesus faithfully.
And there's another benefit.
🎁 And more
We're building a community of believers who want Jesus to be greater than their reputation.
Believers who can serve without applause.
Give without recognition.
Obey without an audience.
And say from the heart:
“He must increase. I must decrease.”
If that is the kind of believer you want to become—
Then do three things:

YOUR GIFT IS STEWARDSHIP.
YOUR PLATFORM IS AN ASSIGNMENT.
YOUR MINISTRY IS NOT YOUR IDENTITY.
THE GLORY BELONGS TO JESUS.
